positive_terms: Disclosure of extent and indication of nature of cases of non-respect of the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, ILO Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work or OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises that involve consumers and/or end-users
涉及消费者和终端用户的未遵守国际人权文书案例
披露涉及消费者和终端用户的、未遵守联合国商业与人权指导原则、ILO基本原则和权利宣言或OECD跨国企业准则的案例性质与范围。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
